Base FHD+ IPS ~300-nit glossy panel unchanged at $1,900
60 Hz non-touch at this price when the Book6 Pro 14 touch was on sale for less

design_philosophy: The Ultra 7 / 512GB tier sits awkwardly in the Book6 14 range: same chassis, panel, and RAM as the Ultra 5, with a faster CPU/iGPU. Its flat $1,899.99 price against the sale-priced Ultra 5 and the same-price 1TB twin makes it the tier to skip — a pricing artifact of Best Buy stocking rather than a distinct product idea.
